50973918.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to CREBBP by SPR method
50973918.references_previous: Poulin, P.; Thiel, F.-P. Prediction of pharmacokinetics prior to in vivo studies. II. Generic physiologically based pharmacokinetic models of drug disposition. J. Pharm. Sci. 2002, 91, 1358–1370.

original_paragraph.Results and Discussion: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) determined a K_D of 49 μM for compound 17 in CREBBP. A T_m shift assay in CREBBP also showed a significantly lower melting temperature for 17 of 1.7 °C at 10 μM. The BET family protein members showed T_m shifts of 2.1–6.5 °C for compound 17. T_m shifts for BAZ2B, PB1(5), and PCAF were less than 1 °C as representative members of bromodomains more distantly related to the BET family.21 Compound 17 is a selective chemical probe for the BET bromodomains.
